method: Personally viewed every original PNG for PDF188–237 and compared the complete English transcription and Chinese translation, including every inline/display formula, heading, paragraph, proof step, exercise and hint, cross-page fragment, and printed source-correction note. The determinant crop was separately viewed and compared with the original. Unclear equality on PDF217 was checked with an original high-resolution crop. Equivalence and implicit context were distinguished from genuine source errors. No delegation was used for this independent second review.
